statement: Read Device unallocated as the remaining space for future allocations, the difference of Device size minus Device allocated; Device allocated also counts reserved but not yet used extents, so free-looking data space may lack room for a new block group.
quote: Device unallocated* -- the remaining unallocated space for future

statement: Read Global reserve as the portion of metadata currently used for the global block reserve and held for emergency work such as deletion on a full filesystem, not as ordinary free metadata.
quote: Global reserve* -- portion of metadata currently used for global
